hook.text: This, then, is how you should pray: ‘Our Father in heaven, may your name be honored as holy,

hook.note: When His own asked how to pray, the Son did not give them a formula. He gave them a Father, and told them to say so out loud. Everything in this Bible follows from that one word. Come, hear your Father’s voice.

short350: Father's Heart Bible™ (FHB) in Swahili — the first Bible in print where you can see who is speaking. Our Father's words in blue, the Son's in red, the Spirit's in purple. A complete 66-book Swahili Bible, paperback and hardcover, made to be given.
Hii ni Biblia ya kwanza iliyochapishwa ambamo unaweza kuona ni nani anayesema. Maneno ya Baba yetu yako kwa rangi ya bluu, maneno ya Mwana kwa rangi nyekundu, na maneno ya Roho kwa rangi ya zambarau.

Kwa zaidi ya karne moja, herufi nyekundu zimeonyesha mahali Mwana anaposema. Lakini Baba yetu anasema zaidi — katika Biblia hii ya Kiswahili, maneno 109,684 katika mistari 5,615 — na hadi sasa kila neno hilo lilichapishwa kwa wino uleule mweusi kama orodha za vizazi. Amekuwa akisema muda wote; hakuna Biblia iliyokuonyesha ni wapi.

Rangi ni alama ya umiliki, si alama ya kunukuu. Maneno yake yanabaki kuwa yake, midomoni mwa yeyote anayeyawasilisha kwa uaminifu; maneno ambayo hakuwahi kuyasema hayatiwi rangi; masimulizi yanabaki meusi.

Wanafunzi wake walipomwuliza jinsi ya kuomba, Mwana hakuwapa mbinu, bali aliwapa Baba: "Baba yetu uliye mbinguni, jina lako litakaswe" (Mathayo 6:9). Kila kitu katika Biblia hii kinatoka katika neno hilo moja. Kwa Roho twalia, "Aba, Baba!" (Warumi 8:15).

Yeye hayuko mbali. Hajakata tamaa nawe. Yeye ni Baba yako wa mbinguni, nawe ni mtoto wake mpendwa. Ikiwa neno baba halikuletei faraja, Biblia hii ni kwa ajili yako zaidi: Baba anayefunuliwa hapa si kivuli cha ubaba wa kibinadamu uliovunjika, bali ndiye ambaye kwake kila jamaa mbinguni na duniani hupata jina lake.
Biblia kamili katika juzuu moja — vitabu 66, sura 1,189, mistari 31,085, bila kufupishwa. Maelezo 1,354 yanamhudumia msomaji, si msomi, na ukurasa wa wakfu unabeba jina la yule unayempa zawadi.

Tafsiri aminifu kutoka Kiebrania, Kiaramu na Kigiriki asilia; kila toleo limetafsiriwa kutoka Father's Heart Bible™. Inchi 6 x 9, jalada laini na jalada gumu, rangi kamili. Zawadi, kumbukumbu, urithi.
Kwa kila familia na kanisa linalozungumza Kiswahili — Tanzania, Kenya, Uganda, Kongo na duniani kote — ili wasikie sauti ya Baba katika lugha yao wenyewe.
Mpokee Baba. Sikia sauti yake. Moyo wake ni kwa ajili yako.

faq.q: Is the Swahili edition the complete Bible?
faq.a: Yes. All 66 books, Genesis to Revelation, in Swahili, 992 pages, full color throughout, in hardcover and paperback.

faq.q: How was the Swahili edition translated?
faq.a: A faithful translation from the original Hebrew, Aramaic and Greek; each edition is translated from the Father's Heart Bible™. The Father's Heart Bible™ itself is translated from the original languages; the Swahili edition is translated from it, so it follows the same text and carries the same Divine Voice Color.

In Divine Voice Color you see who is speaking: our Father's words in BLUE, the Son's in RED, the Spirit's in PURPLE. More than one word in four of the Bible is a divine person speaking. The color is a mark of ownership, not of quotation — His words stay His on any lips that carry them faithfully, and words He never spoke are never colored.

faq.q: Can I read the Swahili text before I buy?
faq.a: Yes. The whole Swahili Bible is free to read at fathersheartbible.com/read/sw.
